name: create_tool_module
description: Creates a new GDScript-based tool in ToolModules/ and hot-registers it to ToolBox. The script must extend BaseTool and override _call(arguments).

module_name.description: Folder name for the new module (plain name, no slashes).

tool_name.description: Unique tool identifier shown to the LLM (snake_case recommended).

description.description: One-sentence description of what the tool does.

script_code.description: Full GDScript source. Must start with 'extends BaseTool' and override '_call(arguments: Dictionary) -> Array'.

input_schema_json.description: JSON string for the tool's parameter schema (OpenAI/JSON Schema format).
